questions.prompt: A 1.6 m boy stands 3.2 m from a 4.8 m lamp post at night. How long is his shadow? Explain with similar triangles.
questions.modelAnswer: Let the shadow be s. The lamp-top, ground and shadow tip form a large triangle similar to the boy’s triangle (AA: both right-angled, sharing the angle at the shadow tip). So 1.6/s = 4.8/(s + 3.2). Then 1.6(s + 3.2) = 4.8s, so 5.12 = 3.2s and s = 1.6 m.
